Welcome to 
STEVENS KITCHENS
Your Dream, Our Goal.

At Stevens Kitchens, we believe your home should be as functional as it is beautiful. As a full-service remodeling company and licensed general contractor, we handle every aspect of your project, including design, labor, materials, and permits. Whether it’s kitchens, bathrooms, or full interior renovations, we are your one-stop shop for a seamless remodeling experience.

​

Our team of designers, project supervisors, and licensed subcontractors works closely with you at every step to ensure thoughtful design, quality craftsmanship, and personalized service. We manage the details so you can focus on enjoying the transformation.

​

Your dream home is closer than you think. Let’s create it together!

Why choose Stevens Kitchens?

Choosing the right remodeling company is just as important as choosing the right materials. At Stevens Kitchens, we set ourselves apart with:

​

Personalized Design Process – We take the time to understand your vision and lifestyle, creating designs that feel custom-tailored to you.

Dedicated Team – Our designers, project supervisors, and licensed subcontractors work hand-in-hand to deliver both beauty and function.

Clear Communication – From your first consultation to the final walkthrough, we keep you updated every step of the way.

Quality Craftsmanship – We partner with trusted vendors and use only materials we believe in, ensuring a remodel that lasts.

Attention to Detail – From showroom cleanliness to the final hardware placement, every detail matters to us.

​

When you choose Stevens Kitchens, you’re choosing a partner who cares about your home as much as you do.

Where It All Started... 

Stevens Kitchens 

In the late 90s, our owner, Steve, started out in the cabinet industry as a service technician for a kitchen cabinet company. This later led to him advancing and becoming an actual installer...

In 2003, Stevens Kitchens Inc. was born! Steve was still an installer, but opened his own business and laid the foundation for what is now, Stevens Kitchens...

Two years later, in 2005, Stevens Kitchens' first showroom was open for browsing. 

Fast forward! After obtaining his General Contractor License in 2015, Steve opened our beautiful, current  showroom on Broadway Street!

Our Consultation Process

We would love to help you get started on your new project! At your initial showroom consultation, you will be able to discuss your overall plans and design goals, so that our designer can provide you with an estimated cost right away. 

​

Prior to your consultation, our designer will ask you for photos and/or relevant information of the space. This allows them to bring your project to life with three-dimensional renderings of your improved space!

 

Once you schedule your in-home measure with your designer, you receive a preliminary estimate, and the fun part begins!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What does an average project cost? 

Typical kitchen, bathroom, and laundry room projects range in price depending on size, materials, and labor needed. 

Full kitchen and master bathroom remodels start at about $35,000, and about $15,000 - $22,000 for laundry rooms and other smaller scaled projects. 

How long does a typical remodel usually take? 

A typical project can range from 6 to 8 weeks. Project timelines can be extended or shortened depending on progress. You see it all! Stevens Kitchens uses a program called BuilderTrend, giving you access to your full project calendar to view at any time. 

Does your company offer financing? 

Yes we do! Our company does have a payment plan that spans throughout your project, but we do, however, offer financing options through multiple financial institutions to meet your needs. For more information, please ask your designer or check our "Contact Us" page to speak to our office. 

How long does an in office consultation typically last? 

In office consultations with our designers can last from 30 minutes to over an hour, depending on the size of your project or number of projects you are looking to complete.
